limits: Unique public query feature IDs are not exact native anchor/glyph counts. Only spacing driver reads version-specific native placements.
No new universal coverage, all overlaps/glyph-edge distance, online basemap, physical device, reader, full browser/200% or performance proof.
Facilities are allowed to yield text to higher-priority names; this change does not remove facility objects or identity.
Historical reports keep original builds; complete MVP including independent human QA remains active.
